svg.title: Sidecar
svg.desc: Sidecar. Run helper capabilities (proxy, logging, config) in a separate process next to the app. Step 1, One unit, two processes: One pod, two containers: shared network, volume and lifecycle; separate image, language and limits. Step 2, Three classic jobs: A proxy carries the app's calls, a log shipper tails its file, a config agent keeps a file fresh. Step 3, Update and reuse: A new proxy version rolls out to every pod: no application image is rebuilt, in any language. Step 4, The price: The price: extra containers in every pod, one more hop per call, and start and stop order matters.

g.text: One pod, two containers: shared network, volume and lifecycle; separate image, language and limits.
A proxy carries the app's calls, a log shipper tails its file, a config agent keeps a file fresh.
A new proxy version rolls out to every pod: no application image is rebuilt, in any language.
The price: extra containers in every pod, one more hop per call, and start and stop order matters.
· one unit: deployed, started, scaled and stopped together

text.class: tiny mono sb f-green sc-w sc-v15a

g.text: network: one IP address, one localhost
restarts: each one on its own
no TLS, retry or log-shipping code
no client library to keep up to date
the same helper for any language
The app calls localhost in plain HTTP.
The proxy adds TLS and retries, and
takes the inbound calls as well.
The app appends to a file on the volume.
The shipper tails it and sends every
The agent fetches secrets and settings
and keeps db.conf up to date.
The app only reads a file.

text.class: tiny mono sb f-green sc-w sc-v15b
tiny mono sb f-green sc-w sc-v15c

g.text: Rolled out pod by pod: each one
one library per language to maintain
every service rebuilt for every fix
one image for all three, no rebuilds
= 20 CPU + 20 GB for the proxies alone
One more hop for every call
